title: The determinant n-covector u ↦ det(⟨g_b, u_a⟩)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and g_0, …, g_{n−1} ∈ ℝ^P. There is an n-covector γ on ℝ^P (a continuous alternating n-linear form, Covector (Euclid P) n) such that γ(u_0, …, u_{n−1}) = det(⟨g_b, u_a⟩)_{a,b ∈ Fin n} for all u_0, …, u_{n−1} ∈ ℝ^P. The matrix has entry ⟨g_b, u_a⟩ in row a and column b; for n = 0 the empty determinant is 1.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (g : Fin n → Euclid P), ∃ γ : Covector (Euclid P) n, ∀ u : Fin n → Euclid P, γ u = Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun a b => inner ℝ (g b) (u a))
